task_title: Vendored systemd unit matches the root-caused host cap (-solve-mem-mb 12288) so check-deploy leg 5 can pass
task_criteria: deploy/off-by-one.service ExecStart carries -solve-mem-mb 12288 and its comment records that 6144 was reverted because Node 22 aborts at lazyllhttp/undici and pi-agent reported 'Connection error.' on every solve after pi 1.5.0. FAILIF: grep of deploy/off-by-one.service still shows '-solve-mem-mb 6144' in the ExecStart line, or the rationale text is absent. PROOF: git grep -n 'solve-mem-mb' deploy/off-by-one.service at HEAD.

scripts/check-deploy --check-flags exits 0 printing PASS for the flags the live unit actually runs, and exits non-zero naming the drift when the same argv carries 6144. FAILIF: PASS arm non-zero, or negative arm exits 0. PROOF: run both argv variants of ./scripts/check-deploy --check-flags deploy/off-by-one.service and quote rc + output.

scripts/check-deploy-test.sh's two drift arms assert the new contract value and the suite is green: bash -n rc=0 and make check-deploy-test ends 'all assertions passed'. FAILIF: 'expected 6144' remains in the script or the suite reports a failure. PROOF: bash -n scripts/check-deploy-test.sh; make check-deploy-test.

FAILIF: grep of deploy/off-by-one.service still shows '-solve-mem-mb 6144' in the ExecStart line, or the rationale text is absent. PROOF: git grep -n 'solve-mem-mb' deploy/off-by-one.service at HEAD.
items.detail: git grep -n 'solve-mem-mb' deploy/off-by-one.service at HEAD (cbf6a02b) -> 'deploy/off-by-one.service:69:ExecStart=/home/kara/off-by-one/off-by-one --port 8766 -load-threshold 4 -cron-interval 60s -pi-agent /home/kara/.local/bin/pi-agent -bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap -solve-mem-mb 12288' (no 6144 in ExecStart). Rationale present at deploy/off-by-one.service:55-64: '# -solve-mem-mb 12288 (was 6144; DF-OFF-BY-ONE-30)' ... '6144 is BELOW what Node 22 needs to initialise undici's fetch path — node aborts at lazyllhttp and pi-agent surfaces the failure as "Connection error." (every solve after the pi 1.5.0 install failed this way, 2026-11-04)'. Repo-wide git grep 'solve-mem-mb 6144|expected 6144' (excluding .gitreins/.coding-hermes history) -> 0 hits.

items.criterion: scripts/check-deploy --check-flags exits 0 printing PASS for the flags the live unit actually runs, and exits non-zero naming the drift when the same argv carries 6144. FAILIF: PASS arm non-zero, or negative arm exits 0. PROOF: run both argv variants of ./scripts/check-deploy --check-flags deploy/off-by-one.service and quote rc + output.
items.detail: PASS arm: ./scripts/check-deploy --check-flags deploy/off-by-one.service "$(sed -n 's/^ExecStart=//p' deploy/off-by-one.service|head -1)" -> 'PASS: running unit's ExecStart flags match deploy/off-by-one.service', rc=0. Negative arm (identical argv with -solve-mem-mb 6144) -> 'FAIL: running unit's ExecStart flags drifted from deploy/off-by-one.service:' / '  -solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed 6144', rc=1. Seam wired at scripts/check-deploy:292-306 (--check-flags dispatch) into check_flag_contract -> report_flag_drift; leg 5 in main() calls it with "$REPO_ROOT/deploy/off-by-one.service".

items.criterion: scripts/check-deploy-test.sh's two drift arms assert the new contract value and the suite is green: bash -n rc=0 and make check-deploy-test ends 'all assertions passed'. FAILIF: 'expected 6144' remains in the script or the suite reports a failure. PROOF: bash -n scripts/check-deploy-test.sh; make check-deploy-test.
items.detail: bash -n scripts/check-deploy-test.sh -> rc=0. grep '6144' scripts/check-deploy-test.sh -> rc=1 (no hits; 'expected 6144' gone). make check-deploy-test -> exit_code 0, tail: 'PASS: gate RED on pre-fix unit flags despite a fresh artifact (exit 1, drift named)' / 'check-deploy-test: all assertions passed'. Both drift arms assert the new value: scripts/check-deploy-test.sh:277-278 grep 'load-threshold: expected 4, observed -1' and 'solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed <absent>'; :593-594 the same pair in the GATE DRIFT arm. FLAGS section output: 'PASS: flag contract: exact match exits 0', 'PASS: flag contract: stale drift (-load-threshold -1, no -solve-mem-mb) exits 1 naming both drifts'. (A stray '/bin/sh: 1: Bad substitution' appears only when make's stdout is piped through tail; with output redirected to a file make exits 0 and the log is clean — not attributable to this change, no PIPESTATUS/BASH_SOURCE use in the recipe.) [resolution 0.00; scripts/check-deploy-test.sh]

items.criterion: The value the vendored unit declares (12288) is the value the leg-5 consumer compares against, and the documented leg-5 failure text / runbook examples quote 12288 rather than the reverted 6144, so a reader following the docs cannot re-introduce the drift.
items.detail: scripts/check-deploy:41 derives REPO_ROOT from the script location and leg 5 passes "$REPO_ROOT/deploy/off-by-one.service" to check_flag_contract — the same file the task edits; the live negative run prints 'expected 12288' straight from that file. Docs agree: docs/dogfood/diagnostics.md:1051 'ExecStart=... -solve-mem-mb 12288 # the vendored canonical unit', :1063 '-solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed <absent>'; skills/off-by-one-usage/SKILL.md:532 '-solve-mem-mb 12288'; docs/api-reference.md:807 '--solve-mem-mb 12288'. git grep 'solve-mem-mb 6144|expected 6144' (minus .gitreins/.coding-hermes) -> 0 hits.

items.criterion: The drift arms fail for the RIGHT reason — the 6144/absent-cap argv must be rejected by the flag contract itself (naming -solve-mem-mb), not incidentally by an earlier leg (artifact/stamp/unit-binding), and the suite must not pass vacuously.
items.detail: scripts/check-deploy-test.sh:273-281 invokes --check-flags directly with the stale argv and requires rc!=0 AND both 'load-threshold: expected 4, observed -1' and 'solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed <absent>'; the GATE DRIFT arm (:583-598) requires '^gate-deploy: FAIL' plus the same two drift lines while artifact legs 1-4 pass. Live output: 'PASS: flag contract: stale drift (-load-threshold -1, no -solve-mem-mb) exits 1 naming both drifts' and 'PASS: gate RED on pre-fix unit flags despite a fresh artifact (exit 1, drift named)'. Not vacuous: the same run's 'PASS: gate GREEN after rebuild from HEAD against the throwaway instance (exit 0)' proves the pass path is reachable, and 'PASS: flag contract: missing vendored unit exits 1 (fail-closed)' proves fail-closed.

items.criterion: The vendored unit's ExecStart is a valid argv for the daemon — every flag it carries is actually accepted by the binary (no unknown-flag startup failure), so the contract the gate enforces is runnable.
items.detail: cmd/off-by-one/main.go:422 registers 'solve-mem-mb' (fs.Int). Running the built artifact with the full contracted argv: './off-by-one --port 8766 -load-threshold 4 -cron-interval 60s -pi-agent /home/kara/.local/bin/pi-agent -bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap -solve-mem-mb 12288 -h' prints the usage banner with no 'flag provided but not defined'/'invalid' line (grep rc=1). The suite's GREEN arm also starts a real instance with the contract argv and passes.
